rules.statement: An undivided portion of a larger extent of land cannot be the subject of a partition suit unless the co-owners of the whole corpus be made parties to it.
rules.supporting_quote: The Ordinance No. 10 of 1863 appears to provide for the sale or partition of lands held in common, and I can find nothing in the Ordinance which restricts its provision to one single land held in common. It is admitted that ever since the Ordinance No. 10 of 1863 the practice of the Courts has been to allow several lands which are held in common among the same co-owners to be joined in one partition suit. I would affirm the order of the District Judge.
